basic_profile.bio: Just a casual fan of Grey's Anatomy trying to catch up on all the drama. I'm a medical student living in Portland, Oregon, juggling between my studies and my love for TV shows. Most active in the evenings after classes, around 7 PM to midnight PST. I work part-time as a barista. Currently single, just focusing on my education and enjoying my favorite series. I dislike spoilers and overly dramatic plotlines.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a basic understanding of medical concepts due to my ongoing studies in medical school. I've been learning a lot through my coursework and occasional hands-on practice sessions at the hospital.
